ProducePagesAsync(BlockingQueue<PageResult<EquatorialStar>>, PageRequest, CancellationToken)

Asynchronously produces pages of data and enqueues them into the specified queue.

public Task ProducePagesAsync(BlockingQueue<PageResult<EquatorialStar>> queue, PageRequest firstPage, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Parameters

queue BlockingQueue<PageResult<EquatorialStar>>

The queue into which the produced pages will be enqueued.

firstPage PageRequest

The initial page request that specifies the starting point for producing pages.

cancellationToken CancellationToken

A token to monitor for cancellation requests. The default value is System.Threading.CancellationToken.None.

Returns

Task

Remarks

This method processes the specified firstPage and continues producing subsequent pages based on the page's configuration. Pages are enqueued into the queue as they are produced. The operation can be canceled by signaling the cancellationToken.
